turns.assessment: The hard, simultaneous loss is localized to the first S02→S10 span: the booster remained normal while OSC was lost on span0 and every downstream amplifier lost input/output power. The reciprocal last span S10→S02 also lost OSC, indicating both fibres of the physical span were severed. Simultaneous equivalent losses toward S19 strongly suggest a common excavation/duct cut near S02 rather than an amplifier or channel fault.

proposals.rationale: OSC loss on E9, loss of all downstream optical power, normal S02→S10 booster telemetry, and loss of the reciprocal fibre precisely localize a hard bidirectional cable break to this physical span. The concurrent S02–S19 break is consistent with multiple cables sharing the cut duct.
An extreme added loss could suppress both payload and OSC, but simultaneous failure of reciprocal fibres and another S02 cable makes a complete fibre cut much more likely.
